The background is a gradient of dark blue to black, creating a somber and reflective mood. At the top of the image, there is a statement in white text that reads: "I've seen about 40 films in last 6 days and no film has had an impact this one made." This text suggests that the film has a profound and lasting impact on the viewer, indicating its significance and emotional depth.
